plugins.name: ailang
plugins.description: Write, run, and develop with AILANG - includes MCP tools, slash commands, and teaching prompts

plugins.name: ailang-lsp
plugins.description: AILANG language server (`ailang lsp --stdio`) for .ail files — diagnostics on save, hover types, go-to-definition, references, document symbols. Requires the `ailang` binary on PATH.

plugins.name: ailang-lens
plugins.description: Live pane of AILANG modules as they are written: functions, types, effect rows and type errors after every .ail edit (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: ailang-brand
plugins.description: AILANG look for Claude Code: the AILANG version beside the prompt hint, compiler-flavoured spinner words (Unifying…, Inferring effects…), and /ailang for a pane with the logo (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: ailang-check-on-edit
plugins.description: After Claude edits or writes a .ail file, runs `ailang check` from the project root and adds any errors to what the model reads after the tool result, so it sees its own type errors without spending a turn (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: ailang-inbox-band
plugins.description: Unread AILANG fleet messages above the prompt: a band with the count and newest title, an /ail-inbox pane with Ack, a toast when one arrives (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: prepush-gate
plugins.description: Runs the repo's CI gates (gofmt on tracked Go roots, make lint, make check-file-sizes when defined) before `git push` / `gh pr create|merge`, and denies the push with the failing output (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: sprint-status
plugins.description: Status line for AILANG sprint work: the most recently touched in-progress sprint under .ailang/state/sprints, its milestones passed and the next one (Claude Code mod)

plugins.name: unowned-dirty
plugins.description: Warns when a git add/stash/checkout/restore/reset may sweep dirty files this session did not write (shared checkouts have several agents) (Claude Code mod)
